model_annotation: This horizontal bar chart illustrates the number of participants associated with each criterion, with the vertical axis listing seven distinct criteria labeled from top to bottom as “Relevant FCs,” “FC Summary,” “Relevance Explanation,” “Clarity and Simplicity,” “Overall Summary,” “Filters,” and “Veracity Explanation,” and the horizontal axis labeled “Number of Participants,” scaled linearly from 0 to 6 with tick marks at intervals of 2. Each criterion is represented by a colored bar extending horizontally from left to right, with the bar length corresponding to the number of participants: “Relevant FCs” has a dark purple bar reaching the value 6; “FC Summary” has a dark teal bar reaching the value 5; “Relevance Explanation” and “Clarity and Simplicity” both have teal bars reaching the value 3; “Overall Summary” has a green bar reaching the value 2; and “Filters” and “Veracity Explanation” both have lighter green bars reaching the value 1. The bars are arranged in descending order of participant count, starting with the longest bar at the top. There are no visual emphases such as shading, bolding, or annotations on any of the bars.
